questions.stem: They said they ____ (come) to see us the next day.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，will 要变 would
缺少表示将来的助动词

questions.explanation: 主句 said 是过去，the next day 指当时的“第二天”，用 would come。

questions.stem: I didn't know whether it ____ rain the next morning.

options.distractor: 主句是过去时，will 要变 would
主句过去，这里说的是当时还没发生的事

questions.explanation: 主句 didn't know 是过去，whether 从句表示之后的可能，用 would rain。

questions.stem: He promised he ____ (help) me with my English.

options.distractor: 主句 promised 是过去时

questions.explanation: promised 是过去，“会帮忙”在当时属于将来，用 would help。

questions.stem: We thought the film ____ (be) very interesting.

options.distractor: 主句 thought 是过去时
“会很有意思”是看之前的判断，不是已看完的结论
主句过去，will 要变 would

questions.explanation: thought 是过去时，当时对“之后观影”的判断用 would be。

options.text: She said she would come to the party.
He told me he would wait for me.
I knew he will be angry.
They said they would try their best.

questions.explanation: 主句 knew 是过去时，从句的 will 要改成 would。

questions.stem: — What did he say? — He said he ____ busy the next day.

options.distractor: the next day 指当时之后的第二天，不是“当时”
主句过去，will 要变 would

questions.explanation: the next day 是“他说话时的第二天”，要用 would be（was 表示他说话那天就忙，意思不同）。
